posts.texte:
In the direct lineage of colonial imagery, Charlie Hebdo, unable to confront the ideas of a Black woman without reducing her to an exoticized, supposedly savage dancing body.  
This hideous cartoon aims to remind me of my place in the racial and sexist hierarchy.
